headline: CLE @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 4.16 at HOU 4.51, with a projected total of 8.67. Batter research is strongest for Yordan Alvarez, Jeremy Peña, Isaac Paredes, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Kahlil Watson, David Fry because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
